prompt: A tennis court: hit the ball past the rival three times

intent.setting: Standard outdoor tennis court with center and service lines, baseline net, and spectator stands
intent.goal: Rally a tennis ball past the rival and the net to land in bounds three times without failing a shot
intent.fail: Failing to hit the ball over the net before the count reaches three or letting the rival return a shot
